thread:
jess: quick sync — we're finalizing the "smoother" that controls how proposed SLO thresholds affect notify routing. goals: avoid notify storms when many tenants change at once, and give ops visibility. thoughts? :eyes:

omar: separate proposal vs effective_apply. proposal = ewma(p95)+alpha*std. smoother computes effective = proposal * weight where weight is a function of global_budget and recent_apply_rate.

li: add local gates first: min_samples, abs_cap, hysteresis. if gate fails, surface "fallback to org_default" in console. also show confidence and sample_count in UI.

jess: config knobs i'm drafting: budget_tokens_per_hour, apply_cost_fn (est_fanout * delta_pct), min_samples=100, max_delta_ms=200, hysteresis_windows=3, initial_weight=0.2, recovery_halflife=6h.

omar: nice. also add global_rate_limit: max_applies_per_min to avoid bursts. and a backpressure hook: if notify_queue_depth > X, smoother pauses and posts a console banner.

li: telemetry: emit proposal_generated, local_gate_outcome, smoother_decision(reason), applied_threshold_event. dashboards: proposed_vs_effective_ts, global_budget_util, applied_rate.

slo-bot: scheduled sim run smoother-sim-2026 cohort=5% start=1749999800 duration=48h. outputs -> /telemetry/smoother/sim/smoother-sim-2026

jess: rollout: sim 48h -> shadow 72h (compute only) -> staged canary (weight=0.2) -> increase if fanout_delta < 5% and no reg alerts. ops kill-switch in console.

omar: one more: add per-org opt-out toggle and an audit log entry each time effective_threshold applied.

deploy-bot: simulation queued at 1749999800; canary window 1750086400-1750088200.

jess: thanks — i'll update the RFC with knobs, API, and dashboard mockups. tagging @omar @li for review. :thumbsup:
